facts.fact: L'Union says Madigipaie is a national QR code digital payment platform for transactions between merchants and users, working with several banks, whose rollout to merchants the economy minister asked Libreville's mayor to support on 3 July 2026.
L'Union says the city of Libreville already has its own operational system for digitalising municipal revenue, developed with the Treasury to secure and modernise collection.
